$description: Eldra Starter design tokens (light theme). Colour roles are what components reference; values are defaults a store may override.

background.$description: Page ground (warm paper). Every block without a section background sits on it. text 16.9:1, muted 7.4:1.

surface.$description: Quiet section background, cards, input read-only fill, image placeholder. text 15.5:1, muted 6.8:1.

surface-strong.$description: Stronger band: footer, skeletons, neutral badge fill, selected rows. text 13.8:1, muted 6.1:1, border-strong 3.6:1.

border.$description: DECORATIVE dividers only: card outlines, table rules, section hairlines. Below 3:1 on purpose, never the only boundary of a control.

border-strong.$description: ADDED ROLE. Boundaries of interactive controls (inputs, checkboxes, switch track, outline button, unselected pills). 4.5:1 on background, 4.1:1 on surface, 3.6:1 on surface-strong (WCAG 1.4.11 needs 3:1).

text.$description: Body copy and headings on background (16.9:1), surface (15.5:1) and surface-strong (13.8:1).

muted.$description: Secondary text: help text, meta lines, captions, placeholders, compare-at prices. 7.4:1 on background, 6.8:1 on surface, 6.1:1 on surface-strong.

primary.$description: Brand slot (default: deep ink). Primary buttons, selected states, links, the 'new' badge, primary section background. Customers drop their brand colour in here; keep primary-contrast at 4.5:1+ against it.

primary-contrast.$description: Text and icons on primary fills (15.6:1).

accent.$description: Clay accent. Secondary buttons, sale badge and sale price, eyebrows, accent section background. 6.4:1 on background, 5.3:1 on surface-strong, so it is safe as text too.

accent-contrast.$description: Text and icons on accent fills (6.7:1).

success.$description: In stock, order delivered, form success. Teal rather than green so it separates from danger for red-green colour blindness; always paired with an icon and a word. 6.2:1 on background, 5.0:1 on surface-strong; background text on it 6.2:1.

warning.$description: Low stock, back-order, shipping delays. Always with an icon and a word. 6.1:1 on background, 5.0:1 on surface-strong; background text on it 6.1:1.

danger.$description: Errors, destructive actions, sold out. Always with an icon and a word. 6.5:1 on background, 5.3:1 on surface-strong; background text on it 6.5:1.

focus.$description: ADDED ROLE. The dark outer ring of the keyboard focus indicator (2px, drawn outside a 2px focus-inner infill). 16.9:1 on background, 15.5:1 on surface, 13.8:1 on surface-strong; 17.5:1 against focus-inner. On dark grounds (primary, accent, overlay, photos) the white infill carries the contrast instead, so the pair is visible on every surface without per-section overrides.

focus-inner.$description: ADDED ROLE. The white infill between a focused control and the focus ring. 16.2:1 against primary, 6.7:1 against accent, 17.5:1 against focus. Never used for anything else.

overlay.$description: ADDED ROLE. Scrim behind dialogs and drawers, and the tint under text laid over images (hero image-background). At 0.7 even a pure white photo leaves primary-contrast text at 6.2:1.

display.$description: Hero heading only. 2.5rem below 48rem container width.

h1.$description: Page title, one per page. 2.125rem below 48rem.

h3.$description: Card group titles, plan names, article subheads.

h4.$description: Card titles, product names, feature titles.

body-sm.$description: Help text, meta lines, small buttons, table cells.

caption.$description: Image captions, legal line, badge text.

overline.$description: Eyebrows above headings. Uppercase via CSS, never typed in caps.

label.$description: Form labels, tab labels, filter group titles.

code.$description: Inline code and code blocks in the Article block.

space-1.$description: Icon-to-text gap inside badges; tight inline gaps.

space-2.$description: Gap between button icon and label, chip gaps, dropdown trigger icon gap.

space-3.$description: Gap inside control groups, list item gaps.

space-4.$description: Card padding (sm), mobile gutter, gap between form rows.

space-5.$description: STACK: default vertical rhythm between elements in a block.

space-6.$description: Card padding (md), tablet gutter, grid gap.

space-8.$description: Desktop gutter, gap between block header and block body.

space-12.$description: Large grid gaps, split-content column gap.

space-16.$description: Gap between rows in split content on desktop.

radius-xl.$description: Hero media, feature panels, CTA banner.

shadow-sm.$description: Sticky header on scroll, hovered product card.

container-narrow.$description: Text-first blocks: article body, newsletter, quote, FAQ.

container-content.$description: Most marketing blocks, product detail, cart page.

container-full.$description: Edge-to-edge media: hero image-background, gallery carousel.

section-sm.$description: Section spacing sm: announcement-adjacent strips, trust strip.

section-md.$description: Section spacing md (default for every block).

section-lg.$description: Section spacing lg: hero, final CTA.

target-min.$description: WCAG 2.5.8 floor for any pointer target (24px).

control-height.$description: Default height of inputs, selects, dropdown triggers, steppers and size pills (40px).

control-height-sm.$description: Compact controls: toolbar sorts, cart quantity, dense filters (32px).

control-height-lg.$description: Large controls: hero newsletter field, checkout email (48px).

focus-width.$description: Width of the dark focus ring (focus).

focus-offset.$description: Width of the white infill (focus-inner) between the control and the ring; also the ring's outline-offset.

duration-fast.$description: Hover and colour changes, focus, switches.

duration-slow.$description: Drawers and dialogs entering. With prefers-reduced-motion every duration becomes 0ms and slides become fades.

ease-out.$description: All entering motion and state changes. Nothing bounces.

z-sticky.$description: Sticky header and sticky buy bar.
